mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item_t (o_id, m_id, m_name, m_price, oi_cnt, oi_total) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{menuId}, #{menuName}, #{menuPrice}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT oi_id AS orderItemId, o_id AS orderId, m_id AS menuId, m_name AS menuName, m_price AS menuPrice, oi_cnt AS quantity, oi_total AS totalPrice FROM order_item_t WHERE o_id = #{orderId}
